description: Defines the QuicSimpleServerBackend interface and its nested RequestHandler class for handling backend responses in a QUIC server implementation.

classes.name: quic::QuicSimpleServerBackend
classes.description: Interface for backend response handling in a QUIC server, including methods for initialization, request processing, and WebTransport support.

classes.name: quic::QuicSimpleServerBackend::RequestHandler
classes.description: Nested interface for handling individual backend requests, including response completion, stream data sending, and error handling.

methods.name: ~QuicSimpleServerBackend
methods.description: Virtual destructor for the backend interface.

methods.name: InitializeBackend
methods.description: Initializes backend with a specified URL.

methods.name: IsBackendInitialized
methods.description: Checks if backend is successfully initialized.

methods.name: SetSocketFactory
methods.description: Sets the socket factory used by the backend.

methods.name: FetchResponseFromBackend
methods.description: Triggers fetching a response from the backend for a given request.

methods.name: HandleConnectHeaders
methods.description: Handles headers for CONNECT requests, default implementation returns 405 error.

methods.name: HandleConnectData
methods.description: Handles data for CONNECT requests, default implementation terminates stream with error.

methods.name: CloseBackendResponseStream
methods.description: Clears the backend response stream state.

methods.name: ProcessWebTransportRequest
methods.description: Processes WebTransport requests, default returns 400 status.

methods.name: SupportsWebTransport
methods.description: Indicates if WebTransport is supported, default false.

methods.name: SupportsExtendedConnect
methods.description: Indicates if extended CONNECT is supported, default true.
